profile.headline:
Experienced Lead Engineer
Disney Streaming / Ex-Spotify
profile.summary: Senior Backend Engineer with over 10 years of experience designing, developing, and scaling high-performance systems at Spotify, eBay, and Intel.

positions.locationName: New York, New York, United States

positions.title: Senior Backend Engineer
positions.description:
● Implemented microservices in Java on GCP, leveraging PostgreSQL, BigQuery, REST, gRPC, Pub/Sub, Kubernetes, and Docker.
● Led the development, launch, and scaling of commerce capabilities for Marquee, Spotify’s first paid ad product, driving over $1M in monthly revenue.
● Spearheaded Marquee’s global expansion, collaborating across cross-functional teams and time zones.
● Platformized commerce for Spotify For Artists, building a scalable, market-agnostic system.
● Led the tech acquisition of SoundBetter into Spotify, developing systems for pay-in, pay-out, and user onboarding.
● Worked on Spotify Stages, building a ticketing system and event management platform.
● Mentored engineers via tech talks, pair programming, and code reviews.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
● Developed eBay's checkout payments backend system using Java, Spring, Oracle Database, and
Cassandra, serving 2 billion daily transactions. This complex system supports users from 190 countries, tailoring experiences with localized languages, shipping methods, payment options, and address formats. Achieved high availability and improved conversion rates through failover mechanisms, multi-region data center distribution, rigorous testing and code reviews, and strategic rollouts with continuous monitoring
● Directed the team to enhance eBay checkout's error handling and conversion rate by collecting and analyzing data from the customer support team. Streamlined errors into blocking and non-blocking categories and refined error experiences. This initiative resulted in a reduction of customer support cases by approximately 100,000 annually
● Effectively led the implementation and launch of eBayPlus, a premium shipping option, by orchestrating cross-team and cross-functional engineering scoping efforts. Utilized remote configurations for feature flags and conducted A/B testing using experimentation platforms to ensure a successful rollout
● Held team accountable of high coding standards with unit testing, automation testing, and code reviews
● Regularly executed code rollouts, conducting production smoke testing, monitoring pool health and data trends, and debugging error and event logs

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
● Implemented software tools in C++ using Visual Studio to validate next-generation Intel products on Visual Studio and Linux platforms
● Led code quality initiatives by managing nightly regression tests and metrics collection
